messages:
sara: I'm handing off for the next 12h — quick notes from this morning's follow-up on PM-2026-04 (kv-cache memory regression). Brief: we rolled a patch (PR 6231) that should fix the leak but we still need a couple verifications before I sign it off.

sara: Open items I care about:
- owner: @kevin to validate no memory growth on staging under the synthetic load.
- owner: @lina to confirm the canary rollout config (min_healthy=2) is applied in prod-canary.
- owner: @jon to confirm alert thresholds for kv-cache mem% were restored (we temporarily relaxed them).

jon: noted. I pushed alert changes in #ops-alerts earlier today — rule id: cache_kv_mem_pct_high. I'll re-enable the stricter thresholds at 14:30 UTC unless kevin vetoes.

kevin: taking the staging validation. plan: run the 30m ramp job and check resident set and kvcache stats. I'll post the exact commands/results here.

kevin: running: ```./scripts/ramp_load.sh --suite=kvcache-smoke --duration=00:30 --concurrency=80``` will send the same pattern as the incident.

kevin: quick heads up — if the leak is fixed we should see stable rss and kvcache.items stay flat after warmup. I'll post graphs in ~40m.

lina: I can't hold prod-canary tonight after 15:00 UTC. If the canary needs manual rollback or pinning to previous model, assign to @michael. Otherwise I can confirm the deployment config before I go at 15:00.

michael: can take the manual rollback if needed. ping me with the canary link or the deployment id. Also if tests fail we should reopen PM-2026-04 rather than close it — I'm fine keeping the ticket open until we have 24h stable. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deployment status: canary/deploy-2026-04-17-6231 -> SUCCESS (3/3 pods ready) at 11:45 UTC.

kevin: results from staging run: rss stable ~870MB -> 880MB (no ramp after warmup), kvcache.items plateaued at 127k. attaching short output: ```avg_rss=875MB
max_rss=882MB
kv_items_start=127120
kv_items_end=127125``` Looks good to me.

jon: thanks. I'll re-enable stricter alerts at 14:30 UTC and set a 1h maintenance window for the canary to avoid noisy pages.

sara: great. action items:
- kevin: mark remediation item #3 in PM-2026-04 as VERIFIED (please include the staging run snippet).
- lina: confirm canary config before 15:00 or reassign to michael.
- jon: re-enable alerts at 14:30 and add the maintenance window.
- michael: standby for rollback if lina cannot.

lina: confirmed the canary config (min_healthy=2, rollout_strategy=linear, step=20%). I will not be available after 15:00 so @michael please take over if anything pops.

michael: got it. I'm watching the canary dashboard. If any regenerated error rate > 2% over baseline I'll start rollback procedure and post the rollback cmd here.

sara: thanks all — I'll update the PM with links and close only after we have 24h stable. tagging the owners in the ticket. Leaving handoff note in the oncall doc. :pray:

kevin: one more note — I saw a small 502 spike during the staging run around minute ~12, looked like a transient upstream timeouts. Not the kvcache leak but I'll open a follow-up if it recurs.

jon: keep an eye on that, if it repeats we'll route to eng-runtime.

sara: signing off. good handoff, please @mention me in the ticket if anything unexpected shows up.
